caption: The drawing depicts two objects, both of which appear to be pieces of tableware. The main object, occupying the central portion of the composition, is an oval platter outlined with a thin rim. Around the edge of the platter runs a continuous decorative border of small pink flowers interspersed with green leaves. Slight shading and contour lines suggest subtle depth and curvature. Below the platter, a smaller circular plate is depicted, also featuring a matching pink floral and green leaf border near the rim. At the top center of the drawing, above the larger platter, is a blue and white heraldic or crest-like emblem enclosed in a rectangular box. The background consists of a neutral, off-white tone, with faintly visible rectangular guidelines framing both the platter and the small plate. A signature is present in blue in the lower middle-right section of the drawing.
title: Cake Saucer
